slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: categories
slots.about: first the all chip with key ""; then key, label, icon (a Tabler name) per kind of event

slots.name: events
slots.about: saved events: id, date, cat (a category key), title, note (may be empty)

slots.name: today_word
slots.about: age of an event from today

slots.name: yesterday_word
slots.about: age of an event from yesterday

slots.name: days_ago_word
slots.about: after the day count, with a leading space

slots.name: empty_line
slots.about: shows when nothing matches the chip and the search

all.shows: every event, newest first; each chip counts its matches

one_kind.shows: only that kind's events; its chip filled

nothing.shows: empty_line in place of the rows

labels.chip: label, count, and picked_word when chosen

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, delay, snappy and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the chosen chip carries picked_word in its label; each row says its kind in words
